name: Fuyuuku
source:
Welcome to Hokkaido.
Drift ice. Lavender fields.
Hot springs. Fresh seafood. Ramen.
Once upon a time,
books introducing this land
were filled with words like these.
The year is 2097.
Beneath the snow-covered landscape,
almost nothing remains.
And yet...
“Let’s go,”
the girl said.
Following the memories buried beneath the snow,
she sets out to fulfill a promise and meet you once again.
Alone together in a land that has forgotten spring,
a girl and an android begin their journey.
For the nth time, and for the very first time,
their journey across Hokkaido begins.

[From the [url=https://fuyouku.com/?ima=0056&lang=en]official website[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到北海道。
流冰。薰衣草花田。
温泉。新鲜海产。拉面。
曾几何时，
介绍这片大地的书籍里，
写满了这样的字眼。
时间来到2097年。
在白雪皑皑的大地之下，
几乎已空无一物。
即便如此……
“出发吧。”
少女如此说道。
追寻着掩埋在积雪之下的记忆，
为了践行约定、与你再度相见，她踏上了旅途。
在遗忘了春天的国度里相依为命，
少女与仿生人启程前行。
这是第无数次，却也是最初的一次——
属于两人的北海道之旅，就此拉开帷幕。

[摘自[url=https://fuyouku.com/?ima=0056&lang=en]官方网站[/url]]
